title: An inverse-stochastic-control Galerkin estimator for drift potentials
summary: We consider the ill-posed inverse problem of recovering the drift potential of an overdamped Langevin diffusion from discrete, possibly irregular position observations. Specializing the suboptimality gap for inverse stochastic control to drift-potential recovery, we parametrize the associated value function in a finite basis. Under a basis nondegeneracy condition, the resulting Galerkin estimator is obtained from one positive-definite linear system whose entries are smooth functionals of the empirical time marginals; no transition density is required.
